newsitem.title: FINLAND: G7 will discuss core financial issues - Summers.
newsitem.headline: G7 will discuss core financial issues - Summers.

text.p: U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Friday that certain core financial issues will continue to be discussed by G7 finance ministers without the participation of Russia.

"It's fair to say that there will be certain core financial issues which will continue to be discussed by the G7 finance ministers and then (by) the G7 finance ministers with their heads of goverment," Summers told a news conference in Helsinki after a U.S.-Russia summit.
"But there certainly will be economic issues that I would anticipate would be discussed in the Summit of the Eight," Summers added.

Summers was commenting on the role Russia will play at the so-called Summit of the Eight meeting to be held in June in Denver, Colorado. The summit will include the leaders of the Group of Seven leading industrialized nations and Russia.

He did not elaborate on which economic issues would be discussed by the G7 and which by the eight nations at Denver. Summers noted "the trend over time has been towards increased Russian participation" in the G7's annual summits.
